subject: @BurnoutAholics Twitter Account
author: ZombieTron
body:
I set up an official BurnoutAholics.com Twitter account! It's @BurnoutAholics if you want to follow us! 🙂 I did it mostly to add 1 more follower for @CriterionGames although I don't think they will make 10,000 before their countdown runs out! 👎

If you haven't already, sign up for Twitter and follow @CriterionGames NOW! Only 1 day to go to get a Crash FM this month!!!

subject: Ten Thousand Twitterers
author: ZombieTron
body:
I was tempted to create a bunch of phoney Twitter accounts just to bump up CG's followers!! I think it sounds like there will be a return to Crash FM regardless... but maybe not this month.

I am happy that the Tweet from CG said Crash FM too and not Crash TV as I really enjoyed the podcast format of Crash FM. 👍

I would love to hear about what the guys and gals at CG have been up to since Big Surf Island hit our consoles. They are getting close, less then 1200 more followers needed!
